result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations setting up a variational (Hamilton-type) principle for a medium with elastic constants a, b, c and a coupling term ε between particle motion and the displacement field, deriving the Euler–Lagrange equations and manipulating the resulting expressions.
result.transcription:
Riemann 18
$[-m-]\sum\left(\frac{dx}{dt}\right)^2 + 2\,\varepsilon\sum\frac{dx}{dt}\xi + a\left(\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial t}\right)^2 + b\sum\left(\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}\right)^2 + (c-b)\left(\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial\zeta}{\partial z}\right)^2 = 2(T+U)$
$\int (T+U)\,dt = \text{Min.}$
$a\frac{\partial^2\xi}{\partial t^2} = b\sum_x\frac{\partial^2\xi}{\partial x^2} + (c-b)\frac{\partial\left(\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial\zeta}{\partial z}\right)}{\partial x} - \frac{\varepsilon\,dx}{dt\,dS}$
$T = \sum a_{\iota,\iota'}x'_\iota x'_{\iota'} + [-...-]$
$\int(\delta T - \delta U)\,dt = \sum\int\left(\frac{\partial T}{\partial x'_\iota}\delta x'_\iota + \frac{\partial(T-U)}{\partial x_\iota}\delta x_\iota\right)dt = \frac{\partial T}{\partial x'_\iota}\delta x_\iota + \int\delta x_\iota\left([-...-] + \frac{\partial(T-U)}{\partial x_\iota}\right)dt$
$\frac{d\frac{\partial T}{\partial x'_\iota}}{dt} = \frac{\partial(T-U)}{\partial x_\iota}$
$m\left(\frac{d^2x}{dt^2} + \varepsilon\frac{d\xi}{dt}\right) = \varepsilon\sum\frac{\partial x_\iota}{\partial x}\frac{dx_\iota}{dt} [-...-] +$
$[-...-]\left(m\frac{d^2x}{dt^2} + \varepsilon\left(\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial t} + \sum\left(\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x_\iota} - \frac{\partial\xi_\iota}{\partial x}\right)\frac{dx_\iota}{dt}\right) - \right) 2\frac{d^2x}{dt^2}dt^2$
$dt^2\,m\left(\frac{d^2x}{dt^2}\right)^2 + 2\varepsilon\left(\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial t} + \sum\left(\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x_\iota} - \frac{\partial\xi_\iota}{\partial x}\right)\frac{dx_\iota}{dt}\right)\frac{d^2x}{dt^2}dt^2 [-+2a...-] + 2U\,dS$
$2a\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial t}\frac{\partial^2\xi}{\partial t\,\partial x_\iota}\frac{d^2x_\iota}{dt^2}dt^2$
$2a\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial t}\frac{d^2\xi}{dt^2}dt$
$m\left(\frac{d^2x}{dt^2}\right)^2 + 2\varepsilon\sum\left(\frac{d\xi}{dt}\frac{d^2x}{dt^2} - \frac{d^2\xi}{dt^2}[-\frac{dx}{dt}-]\right)dt^2$
$[-m\left(\frac{d^2x}{dt^2}\right)^2 + 2\varepsilon\left(\frac{dx}{dt}\right)^2\frac{d\xi}{dt}-] + a\left(\frac{\partial^2\xi}{\partial t^2}\right)^2 dt^2 + 2U [-...-]$
$+ a\,d[-...-]\frac{d\xi}{dt}\frac{d^2\xi}{dt^2}dt^2$
$- a\,d\left(\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial t}\right)^2 dt$
$+ b\,2\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}\frac{\partial^3\xi}{\partial x\,\partial t^2}$
$\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial t}\frac{d\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial t}}{dt}dt^2$
$d\left(\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial t}\right)^2 dt$
